flags.detail: The issuer's own terms contradict themselves inside this tier. The heading says "Spend $75 and get $25" and the bolded requirement says "Receipt(s) must contain at least $75 worth of participating products … to receive a $25 Reward", but the body sentence in between reads "purchase $50 worth of participating products" — the $50 figure copied from tier 2. The $75 threshold is recorded here because it appears twice (heading and bolded requirement) against the body's single $50, but the issuer has not corrected the text and a claimant should assume the HIGHER threshold. Do not rely on the $50 reading.

Two dates govern this offer: qualifying products must be PURCHASED between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-30, and the claim must be SUBMITTED online by 2026-10-14. 'expires' stores the submission deadline, matching how the P&G × Costco rebate is recorded in this dataset. As of the 2026-09-22 verification date there were 8 days left to buy and 22 days left to submit.

The terms introduce the tiers with "There are two (2) ways to redeem an Offer and receive a Sponsor-specified prepaid card" and then enumerate three numbered tiers (1. Spend $75/$25, 2. Spend $50/$15, 3. Spend $20/$5). All three are published on the same page and the hub page carries the same rebate; the "two (2)" wording is an unrepaired artefact of an earlier two-tier version of the promotion.

Claiming requires registering or logging in as a P&G brandSAVER member (free), plus name, address, email, date of birth (MM/YYYY), receipt photos and per-item UPCs. The issuer also states that using the service consents to collection of consumer health data under the P&G Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy, with withdrawal available through P&G's preference centre.

The issuer states the prepaid card ships "within 6 to 8 weeks of receipt of your submission", i.e. a claim submitted on the 2026-10-14 deadline would be paid roughly late November 2026 to mid-December 2026. The Reward is not cash: it is "not redeemable for cash or cash equivalents" and is "subject to prepaid card issuer's terms & conditions".

"AVAILABLE ON A FIRST-COME, FIRST-SERVED BASIS WHILE SUPPLIES LAST. QUANTITIES ARE LIMITED." and "If Rewards are available, then the Participant can follow the on-screen instructions to claim a Reward" — the terms make availability conditional, so the offer may be gone before the printed expiry.
